장유장 (jangyujang).definition:
Korean tag for the fictional ship between Josuke Higashikata and Yukako Yamagishi from the anime [Jojo's Bizarre Adventure], specifically in [Diamond Is Unbreakable]. Has [the principal] argument of both of them are hair lovers.
Although isn't a very popular ship, they have many tags. In korean, that tag can be 장유장 (jangyujang) or simply 장유 (jangyu), but most used is 장유장(jangyujang)
장유장 (jangyujang).example:
- [What is]장유장 (jangyujang)?
- Is the [shipping] between Josuke and Yukako from DIU. [I love it]!
- Oh, do you ship them? Me too! They are so cute togheter!
